cards.headline: The tape: a mixed, rotational tape, 48% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.32% · WTI +0.21% · Brent -0.40% · NatGas +1.61%. 48% of 67 energy names are green — a mixed, rotational tape. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +6.25%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Shale & E&P lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +6.25%; weakest is Shale & E&P at -1.86%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: ARRY is the standout at +22.50%
cards.body: Leaders: ARRY +22.50%, BE +8.91%, SEDG +8.72%, ENPH +8.56%, TLN +7.79%. Laggards: FANG -3.28%, MPLX -2.39%, APA -2.13%, PEG -2.12%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
